title: Low-Temperature Induction Reduces Inclusion-Body Formation of SynLig-B Without Changing Total Expression
authors: Ari Kess, Hana Miro, and Zoe Lorn | Synthetic Expression Archive
research_question: Does low-temperature induction improve SynLig-B solubility, and is the improvement due to greater total expression?
methods: 30 C for 6 h vs 16 C for 18 h
key_findings: Soluble yield increased from 1.9 to 5.8 mg/L
conclusion: Low temperature improved partitioning into the soluble fraction rather than total expression.
critical_negations: Apparent molecular mass did not change
forbidden_claims: The 16 C sample was induced for 6 h
